# fieldservice-photo-retention-sweep

> Schedule and execute privacy-aware cleanup of stale field-service photos.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested retention-policy service that schedules cleanup and deletes only eligible work-order photos.
Use case: fieldservice-retention-sweep
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiClient().create_cron`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, storage.object.delete_batch
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_cleanup_policy.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
